Pocket Studio for Supabase</h2> <div class="article-body"> <div style="text-align:center; margin:20px 0;"> <script type="text/javascript"> atOptions = {'key' : 'f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2','format' : 'iframe','height' : 90,'width' : 728,'params' : {}}; </script> <script type="text/javascript" src="https://upholdbrilliancerecast.com/f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2/invoke.js"></script> </div> <div class="article-body" style="font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8; color: #333;"> <p><p> Supabase dashboard & SQL editor for Android </p> <p> <a href="https://www.producthunt.com/products/pocket-studio-for-supabase?utm_campaign=producthunt-atom-posts-feed&utm_medium=rss-feed&utm_source=producthunt-atom-posts-feed">Discussion</a> | <a href="https://www.producthunt.com/r/p/1314746?app_id=339">Link</a> </p></p> <p style="margin-top: 25px;"> <a href="https://www.producthunt.com/products/pocket-studio-for-supabase" target="_blank" rel="nofollow noopener" style="color: #0d6efd; text-decoration: none; font-weight: bold;"> → Baca artikel asli </a> </p> </div> <div style="text-align:center; margin:20px 0;"> <script type="text/javascript"> atOptions = {'key' : 'f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2','format' : 'iframe','height' : 90,'width' : 728,'params' : {}}; </script> <script type="text/javascript" src="https://upholdbrilliancerecast.com/f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2/invoke.js"></script> </div> </div> </article> <article class="article-card" id="artikel-9587"> <h2>#9587. The secret to make-ahead pie crust? Pie crumbs.: Get ahead on your pie baking right now.</h2> <div class="article-body"> <div style="text-align:center; margin-bottom:20px;"><img src="https://www.kingarthurbaking.com/sites/default/files/2026-10/pie%20crumsb.jpg" alt="The secret to make-ahead pie crust? Pie crumbs.: Get ahead on your pie baking right now." style="max-width:100%; height:auto; border-radius:8px;" loading="lazy"></div> <div style="text-align:center; margin:20px 0;"> <script type="text/javascript"> atOptions = {'key' : 'f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2','format' : 'iframe','height' : 90,'width' : 728,'params' : {}}; </script> <script type="text/javascript" src="https://upholdbrilliancerecast.com/f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2/invoke.js"></script> </div> <div class="article-body" style="font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8; color: #333;"> <p>'Tis the season — to start thinking about holiday baking. And while this time of year is full of joy and celebration, it can also be stressful. We’re all searching for ways to get ahead of the curve, and one of the easiest? Make-ahead pie crust, made using pie crumbs.</p> <p>I first learned of this technique from a 90-something friend with whom I love to talk baking. Over lunch one day, something she said about pie captured my attention.</p> <p>"Did you ever hear of pie crumbs?" she asked. I admitted I hadn't — aside from the obvious: the scraps of pie crust left on the plate after the slice is gone. "My mother used to mix flour and salt and lard together to make this crumbly mixture that she'd store in a crock in the cellar. She called them her pie crumbs. When she wanted to make a pie, she'd just scoop out a few handfuls, add water, and roll out her crust."</p> <p>Sounds like a good make-ahead solution for 100 years ago — but now that we have easy access to freezers, why not just make pie dough and freeze it in ready-to-roll disks? A couple of reasons, actually.</p> <p>1) Pie crumbs allow you to make any amount of crust, from mini apple pies to a crust for a deep-dish 10" pie. With frozen disks, you're looking at a standard single crust — not always exactly what you want.</p> <p>2) Pie crumbs save time. Remove however much of the crumbly mixture you need (more on this below) from the freezer, and within 15 minutes the fat is soft enough that you can add water and roll out your crust. Compare that to the hours it takes to thaw and roll a frozen disk of prepared crust — not to mention the elbow grease if your crust isn’t fully thawed.</p> <p>3) Pie crumbs can be more stable in the freezer than pie crust disks. Why? Because without the added water, no ice crystals form. Ice crystals can damage the flour/water matrix, leading to changes in its structure (which can then potentially lead to changes in your pie crust).</p> <p>Oh, and one other reason I like pie crumbs: If my friend's mother used them, they were probably a 19th-century kitchen time-saver. And I love the feeling of preserving and carrying forward our American baking traditions — even something as simple as a shortcut for pie crust.</p> <p>Choose a standard pie crust recipe: Our Classic Double Pie Crust recipe is good choice, but anything that involves cutting fat into flour (lard, shortening, butter, etc.) will work.</p> <p>Mix flour, salt, and shortening and/or butter: Follow your recipe up until all of the fat is incorporated into the flour. You should be left with a bowl of dry, crumbly dough that barely holds together when squeezed. If using butter, you should be able to see visible chunks scattered throughout the dough.</p> <p>Weigh the pie crumbs: If you’re making a large batch of pie crumbs, it’s helpful to weigh and label the total gram amount so that you can easily remove the amount of pie crumbs for a single pie crust as needed. Our Classic Double Pie Crust makes 488 grams of pie crumbs; that means 244 grams per single pie crust. Label these amounts on your freezer storage bag.</p> <p>Bag, label, and freeze the crumbs: Seal pie crumbs in an airtight, freezer-safe bag and place in the freezer, preferably in the back where it won't be subject to warm air wafting over it each time you open the freezer door.</p> <p>Scoop crumbs out of the bag into a bowl: Whether one crust, two crusts, or one and a half, do the math and measure the crumbs based on your recorded gram amounts.</p> <p>Let the crumbs thaw for 15 to 20 minutes or so: Wait until the butter chunks feel barely pliable in your fingers.</p> <p>Add water and mix: Add water based on your original recipe amount, or just enough water to make a chunky mass when mixed. Squeeze and knead the dough briefly; all you're doing here is bringing the chunks together into one solid piece of dough.</p> <p>Roll the dough, place in a pan, and bake accordingly: From here, your pie crust is the same as any fresh-made crust and can be filled and baked or prebaked for a no-bake filling. (Bonus: Because the crumbs were frozen and remain cold as you work with them, there's no need to chill your rolled-out crust before filling and/or baking.)</p> <p>Fairly indefinitely, though the longer they're frozen, the more chance they have both to absorb freezer odors, and for the fats to start to go off. I've also found that, after about two weeks in the freezer, I need to add a touch more water than usual to bring the dough together — due to the drying effects inherent in freezing.</p> <p>With pie season hard upon us, now's the time to try pie crumbs for make-ahead pie crust. Or maybe you have another old-fashioned pie trick up your sleeve? Share your favorite tips in the comments, below.</p> <p>For detailed ingredient amounts for the crust demonstrated above, see our recipe for Classic Double Pie Crust.</p> <p>And if you're looking for additional time-saving ways to use your freezer in the run-up to the holidays, check out our recipe for Homemade Brown and Serve Rolls and Apple Pie with Make-Ahead Filling.</p> <p>Cover photo and food styling by Liz Neily.</p> <p>Top tips from the Things Bakers Know podcast.</p> <p>Mini pies may be the secret to a stress-free celebration.</p> <p>See our complete collection of Tips and Techniques posts.</p> <p>Top tips from the Things Bakers Know podcast.</p> <p>Mini pies may be the secret to a stress-free celebration.</p> <p>Because we're all wondering what to do with our apple and pumpkin pies.</p> <p>Facebook TikTok Instagram Threads Pinterest LinkedIn YouTube Reddit Substack</p> <p style="margin-top: 25px;"> <a href="https://www.kingarthurbaking.com/blog/2026/10/26/make-ahead-pie-crust" target="_blank" rel="nofollow noopener" style="color: #0d6efd; text-decoration: none; font-weight: bold;"> → Baca artikel asli </a> </p> </div> <div style="text-align:center; margin:20px 0;"> <script type="text/javascript"> atOptions = {'key' : 'f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2','format' : 'iframe','height' : 90,'width' : 728,'params' : {}}; </script> <script type="text/javascript" src="https://upholdbrilliancerecast.com/f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2/invoke.js"></script> </div> </div> </article> <article class="article-card" id="artikel-9586"> <h2>#9586. Kairos</h2> <div class="article-body"> <div style="text-align:center; margin:20px 0;"> <script type="text/javascript"> atOptions = {'key' : 'f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2','format' : 'iframe','height' : 90,'width' : 728,'params' : {}}; </script> <script type="text/javascript" src="https://upholdbrilliancerecast.com/f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2/invoke.js"></script> </div> <div class="article-body" style="font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8; color: #333;"> <p><p> Personal analytics engine across health, finances, & social </p> <p> <a href="https://www.producthunt.com/products/kairos-18?utm_campaign=producthunt-atom-posts-feed&utm_medium=rss-feed&utm_source=producthunt-atom-posts-feed">Discussion</a> | <a href="https://www.producthunt.com/r/p/1307926?app_id=339">Link</a> </p></p> <p style="margin-top: 25px;"> <a href="https://www.producthunt.com/products/kairos-18" target="_blank" rel="nofollow noopener" style="color: #0d6efd; text-decoration: none; font-weight: bold;"> → Baca artikel asli </a> </p> </div> <div style="text-align:center; margin:20px 0;"> <script type="text/javascript"> atOptions = {'key' : 'f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2','format' : 'iframe','height' : 90,'width' : 728,'params' : {}}; </script> <script type="text/javascript" src="https://upholdbrilliancerecast.com/f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2/invoke.js"></script> </div> </div> </article> <article class="article-card" id="artikel-9585"> <h2>#9585. Give Boxed Cake Mix A British-Style Upgrade With Cream And One Jarred Ingredient</h2> <div class="article-body"> <div style="text-align:center; margin-bottom:20px;"><img src="https://www.foodrepublic.com/img/gallery/give-boxed-cake-mix-a-british-style-upgrade-with-cream-and-one-jarred-ingredient/l-intro-1794324813.jpg" alt="Give Boxed Cake Mix A British-Style Upgrade With Cream And One Jarred Ingredient" style="max-width:100%; height:auto; border-radius:8px;" loading="lazy"></div> <div style="text-align:center; margin:20px 0;"> <script type="text/javascript"> atOptions = {'key' : 'f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2','format' : 'iframe','height' : 90,'width' : 728,'params' : {}}; </script> <script type="text/javascript" src="https://upholdbrilliancerecast.com/f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2/invoke.js"></script> </div> <div class="article-body" style="font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8; color: #333;"> <p>We may receive a commission on purchases made from links.</p> <p>Anyone who believes British cuisine falls short has likely never experienced a British cake, with notable example being a traditional Victoria sponge. Much like a classic cup of tea, this dessert represents the essence of British baking, offering elegance through simple ingredients. Even novice bakers can easily prepare one from scratch, but using a boxed cake mix offers a far more convenient alternative. Upgrading a simple store-bought mix into an authentic Victoria sponge requires just one key addition to your pantry: a good jar of strawberry or raspberry jam.</p> <p>Jam is at the heart of a Victoria sponge. The cake consists of two light, fluffy sponge layers sandwiched together with jam and whipped cream. Early versions of this cake, which trace back to Victorian-era afternoon tea culture heavily championed by Queen Victoria, were most commonly filled with just raspberry jam, no cream. Today, however, many bakers include a layer of whipped cream or vanilla buttercream alongside the jam, although traditionalists still debate the "proper" filling.</p> <p>Adding jam to a Victoria sponge sounds simple enough, but there is an art to it. Before assembling the cake, make sure that each sponge layer has cooled completely. This typically takes about 20 to 30 minutes after removing the layers from the oven. If you assemble the cake while it is still warm, the jam (and cream) will melt and run, ruining the distinctive layers that give the Victoria sponge its elegant charm. It is also important to use the right amount of jam — too little will be unnoticeable, while too much will ooze out. A helpful tip is to leave a small border around the outer edge of the bottom sponge so that when the top layer is added, the jam spreads outward without spilling over.</p> <p>The Victoria sponge might be an old-school recipe, but there's always room for improvement. While we'd advocate for experimentation, a Victoria sponge is almost always a golden-yellow sponge. There's no going wrong with a chocolate boxed cake mix, but if you want to keep things traditional (and avoid the wrath of the Brits), it's best to toss a yellow cake mix into your cart. To make life easier, we've already ranked Betty Crocker's Super Moist Yellow Cake Mix as one of the best you can buy.</p> <p>Although a Victoria sponge might sound simple, there are, pardon the pun, levels to this cake. Assembling the sponge is easy enough, but the jam and cream are where you can really let your baking skills speak for themselves. Instead of jarred jam, you could make your own. Sure, it's not as convenient, but your taste buds will thank you. Simply combine diced raspberries or strawberries with lemon juice and sugar, leave it for an hour, then simmer over medium-low heat until it reaches your desired consistency — or consider making a jarringly beautiful ruby red jam. Let it cool completely before spreading, so it doesn't seep into the sponge. Homemade jam will completely elevate your boxed cake mix, and it certainly won't go unnoticed by guests.</p> <p>The cream also offers plenty of room for improvement. The standard approach is a thick layer of homemade whipped cream over the bottom layer, but there are some easy (and more flavourful) upgrades. Whip a few spoonfuls of mascarpone into the cream for a richer, tangier filling, or scrape in some vanilla bean paste, lemon zest, or a splash of elderflower cordial for something brighter. For a nod to a classic British cream tea, swap in clotted cream, which will pair perfectly with the jam. To make clotted cream (because you won't find it in most stores), simmer about three cups of heavy cream with an ounce of unsalted butter until it reduces by half. Chill it overnight, and Bob's your uncle.</p> <p style="margin-top: 25px;"> <a href="https://www.foodrepublic.com/2312051/give-boxed-cake-mix-british-style-upgrade-cream-jarred-ingredient/" target="_blank" rel="nofollow noopener" style="color: #0d6efd; text-decoration: none; font-weight: bold;"> → Baca artikel asli </a> </p> </div> <div style="text-align:center; margin:20px 0;"> <script type="text/javascript"> atOptions = {'key' : 'f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2','format' : 'iframe','height' : 90,'width' : 728,'params' : {}}; </script> <script type="text/javascript" src="https://upholdbrilliancerecast.com/f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2/invoke.js"></script> </div> </div> </article> <article class="article-card" id="artikel-9584"> <h2>#9584. Gemini 4 Hydrogen</h2> <div class="article-body"> <div style="text-align:center; margin:20px 0;"> <script type="text/javascript"> atOptions = {'key' : 'f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2','format' : 'iframe','height' : 90,'width' : 728,'params' : {}}; </script> <script type="text/javascript" src="https://upholdbrilliancerecast.com/f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2/invoke.js"></script> </div> <div class="article-body" style="font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8; color: #333;"> <p><p> Fast agentic development for coders </p> <p> <a href="https://www.producthunt.com/products/gemini-6?utm_campaign=producthunt-atom-posts-feed&utm_medium=rss-feed&utm_source=producthunt-atom-posts-feed">Discussion</a> | <a href="https://www.producthunt.com/r/p/1314458?app_id=339">Link</a> </p></p> <p style="margin-top: 25px;"> <a href="https://www.producthunt.com/products/gemini-6" target="_blank" rel="nofollow noopener" style="color: #0d6efd; text-decoration: none; font-weight: bold;"> → Baca artikel asli </a> </p> </div> <div style="text-align:center; margin:20px 0;"> <script type="text/javascript"> atOptions = {'key' : 'f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2','format' : 'iframe','height' : 90,'width' : 728,'params' : {}}; </script> <script type="text/javascript" src="https://upholdbrilliancerecast.com/f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2/invoke.js"></script> </div> </div> </article> <article class="article-card" id="artikel-9583"> <h2>#9583. For A Juicier Burger, Make It Scottish-Style</h2> <div class="article-body"> <div style="text-align:center; margin-bottom:20px;"><img src="https://www.foodrepublic.com/img/gallery/for-a-juicier-burger-make-it-scottish-style/l-intro-1794336334.jpg" alt="For A Juicier Burger, Make It Scottish-Style" style="max-width:100%; height:auto; border-radius:8px;" loading="lazy"></div> <div style="text-align:center; margin:20px 0;"> <script type="text/javascript"> atOptions = {'key' : 'f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2','format' : 'iframe','height' : 90,'width' : 728,'params' : {}}; </script> <script type="text/javascript" src="https://upholdbrilliancerecast.com/f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2/invoke.js"></script> </div> <div class="article-body" style="font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8; color: #333;"> <p>Even if you have the perfect blend of meats, some burger patties can stand a little extra moisture to keep them juicy after exposure to high heat. While it may be a less conventional choice, black pudding has a remarkable capacity to make burgers juicier, and the method is actually quite similar to other juicy ground meat recipes.</p> <p>Black pudding is a type of blood sausage consisting of a congealed blend of oats, spices, animal blood, and sometimes assorted organ meats. The use of oats is quite similar to using milk-soaked breadcrumbs in meatballs to keep them moist. When you introduce a bit of black pudding into burgers, the oats can help retain moisture within the patties, keeping them juicy. This helps maintain a consistent level of moisture without adding excess liquid that could inhibit a good crust.</p> <p>While you can always use breadcrumbs or other conventional ingredients instead, black pudding is far meatier and more similar to a patty's flavor profile. Rich in umami and seasonings of its own, it adds so much more than just juiciness. Black pudding can also crisp up on a grill, griddle, or in a pan, so you won't be sacrificing texture for the sake of moisture. Using roughly one part black pudding to two parts meat ensures you can taste both and get a proper level of juiciness, even when using lean blends.</p> <p>Black pudding is something you may rarely encounter in the U.S., and regional varieties can make it difficult to find the perfect one for burger patties. While just about any type can get the job done, texture and flavor profile are important considerations, and you'll have to mix it in properly for the best results.</p> <p>Black pudding isn't monolithic and ranges from the crisped discs served in a full English breakfast to boudin noir in France. The crumbly texture of Scottish black pudding is ideal and makes it easier to add to a burger blend, whether that's beef or another meat mixture. When ingredients are easy to incorporate, it prevents you from overworking the meat and helps you grill burgers like a pro, achieving a tender result that doesn't firm up into a sausage puck. Scottish varieties also make ample use of oatmeal as a binder, so you're more likely to get that juiciness you want.</p> <p>Scottish black puddings also tend to keep the seasonings quite simple, creating something delicious but not overly complex. By focusing on a simple blend of salt, pepper, and aromatics, they leave you more room to season your burgers to your liking. While boudin noir is delicious thanks to its blend of spices like nutmeg, these can easily clash with what's in your seasoning cabinet and make pairings difficult. Simple seasonings also let you add more to your blend, so you don't have to worry so much about ratios.</p> <p style="margin-top: 25px;"> <a href="https://www.foodrepublic.com/2312401/juicier-burger-make-scottish-style-black-pudding/" target="_blank" rel="nofollow noopener" style="color: #0d6efd; text-decoration: none; font-weight: bold;"> → Baca artikel asli </a> </p> </div> <div style="text-align:center; margin:20px 0;"> <script type="text/javascript"> atOptions = {'key' : 'f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2','format' : 'iframe','height' : 90,'width' : 728,'params' : {}}; </script> <script type="text/javascript" src="https://upholdbrilliancerecast.com/f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2/invoke.js"></script> </div> </div> </article> <article class="article-card" id="artikel-9582"> <h2>#9582. Paxper</h2> <div class="article-body"> <div style="text-align:center; margin:20px 0;"> <script type="text/javascript"> atOptions = {'key' : 'f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2','format' : 'iframe','height' : 90,'width' : 728,'params' : {}}; </script> <script type="text/javascript" src="https://upholdbrilliancerecast.com/f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2/invoke.js"></script> </div> <div class="article-body" style="font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8; color: #333;"> <p><p> Create cloud infrastructure visually and review every change </p> <p> <a href="https://www.producthunt.com/products/paxper?utm_campaign=producthunt-atom-posts-feed&utm_medium=rss-feed&utm_source=producthunt-atom-posts-feed">Discussion</a> | <a href="https://www.producthunt.com/r/p/1314567?app_id=339">Link</a> </p></p> <p style="margin-top: 25px;"> <a href="https://www.producthunt.com/products/paxper" target="_blank" rel="nofollow noopener" style="color: #0d6efd; text-decoration: none; font-weight: bold;"> → Baca artikel asli </a> </p> </div> <div style="text-align:center; margin:20px 0;"> <script type="text/javascript"> atOptions = {'key' : 'f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2','format' : 'iframe','height' : 90,'width' : 728,'params' : {}}; </script> <script type="text/javascript" src="https://upholdbrilliancerecast.com/f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2/invoke.js"></script> </div> </div> </article> <article class="article-card" id="artikel-9581"> <h2>#9581. Evaporated vs. condensed milk: What's the difference? : Navigating the canned dairy aisle.</h2> <div class="article-body"> <div style="text-align:center; margin-bottom:20px;"><img src="https://www.kingarthurbaking.com/sites/default/files/2026-10/Evaporated%20vs%20Condensed%20milk_Blog_2026_Shot%201_ALT_0045.jpg" alt="Evaporated vs. condensed milk: What's the difference? : Navigating the canned dairy aisle." style="max-width:100%; height:auto; border-radius:8px;" loading="lazy"></div> <div style="text-align:center; margin:20px 0;"> <script type="text/javascript"> atOptions = {'key' : 'f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2','format' : 'iframe','height' : 90,'width' : 728,'params' : {}}; </script> <script type="text/javascript" src="https://upholdbrilliancerecast.com/f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2/invoke.js"></script> </div> <div class="article-body" style="font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8; color: #333;"> <p>Navigating the dairy section at the grocery store is one thing, but when it comes to the canned stuff, how much do you know about the difference between evaporated milk and condensed milk?</p> <p>Before we discuss what sets evaporated milk apart from condensed milk, it’s important to discuss their similarities. Evaporated milk and condensed milk are both concentrated liquids made from fresh milk that gets heat-treated until about 60% of the water content is removed. The primary difference between the two is the amount of sugar they contain and their resulting texture.</p> <p>Evaporated milk will typically only contain lactose, or the naturally occurring sugars found in milk and dairy products. Condensed milk, on the other hand, contains around 40 to 45% added sugar. That contrast means condensed milk is much thicker (almost syrupy) and has a more pronounced sweet flavor (it’s no wonder it’s often referred to as sweetened condensed milk!), and evaporated milk runs watery in texture and is lighter in taste.</p> <p>Because of the extreme differences in the sugar content and consistency, evaporated milk and condensed milk cannot be used interchangeably. There will be a very noticeable difference if you use evaporated milk in a recipe that was written to use condensed milk, or vice versa.</p> <p>Using evaporated in a recipe that calls for condensed milk will result in a dessert that is too bland and watery, while using condensed milk in a recipe that calls for evaporated milk can make a dish way too sweet and thick. If your recipe calls for a very small amount (1 to 2 tablespoons) of condensed milk, you could get away with combining a spoonful of evaporated milk mixed with some sugar. But if your recipe needs one whole can of evaporated or condensed milk, be sure to use the correct type.</p> <p>If you want to learn more about – and celebrate – the differences between evaporated and condensed milk, make this Tres Leches Cake, which is a fantastic recipe that utilizes the two milks with heavy cream in a luscious cake soak for dessert. For a different dose of double the milk, you’ll want to try this creamy, custardy Vanilla Bean Flan.</p> <p>Evaporated milk provides richness and creaminess to dishes that are both sweet and savory. It’s often used to enrich custard-based pie fillings, like Hong Kong Egg Tarts, Delicata Squash Pie, and Pumpkin Pie. To round out your fall table and use up that can of evaporated milk, try the dairy ingredient in dinner recipes like Pumpkin Soup and Creamy Tomato Soup, or macaroni and cheese.</p> <p>If you have an unopened can of condensed milk, you can also make dulce de leche with it. One way to go about it is to let it simmer in a pan filled with water for a few hours: Learn how to make it here.</p> <p>Cover photo by Patrick Marinello; food styling by Yekaterina Boytsova.</p> <p>Justine Lee is a food writer, recipe developer, and culinary consultant based in New York City. In her free time, she is actively on a hunt for a good almond croissant.</p> <p>Top tips from the Things Bakers Know podcast.</p> <p>Mini pies may be the secret to a stress-free celebration.</p> <p>See our complete collection of Tips and Techniques posts.</p> <p>The best potato flour substitutes for when you run short.</p> <p>Facebook TikTok Instagram Threads Pinterest LinkedIn YouTube Reddit Substack</p> <p style="margin-top: 25px;"> <a href="https://www.kingarthurbaking.com/blog/2026/10/30/evaporated-vs-condensed-milk" target="_blank" rel="nofollow noopener" style="color: #0d6efd; text-decoration: none; font-weight: bold;"> → Baca artikel asli </a> </p> </div> <div style="text-align:center; margin:20px 0;"> <script type="text/javascript"> atOptions = {'key' : 'f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2','format' : 'iframe','height' : 90,'width' : 728,'params' : {}}; </script> <script type="text/javascript" src="https://upholdbrilliancerecast.com/f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2/invoke.js"></script> </div> </div> </article> <article class="article-card" id="artikel-9580"> <h2>#9580. </script> <script type="text/javascript" src="https://upholdbrilliancerecast.com/f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2/invoke.js"></script> </div> </div> </article> <article class="article-card" id="artikel-9577"> <h2>#9577. Add This Creamy Ingredient To Tuna Salad For A Major Flavor Boost (Hint: It's Not Mayo Or Yogurt)</h2> <div class="article-body"> <div style="text-align:center; margin-bottom:20px;"><img src="https://www.foodrepublic.com/img/gallery/add-this-creamy-ingredient-to-tuna-salad-for-a-major-flavor-boost-hint-its-not-mayo-or-yogurt/l-intro-1794333459.jpg" alt="Add This Creamy Ingredient To Tuna Salad For A Major Flavor Boost (Hint: It's Not Mayo Or Yogurt)" style="max-width:100%; height:auto; border-radius:8px;" loading="lazy"></div> <div style="text-align:center; margin:20px 0;"> <script type="text/javascript"> atOptions = {'key' : 'f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2','format' : 'iframe','height' : 90,'width' : 728,'params' : {}}; </script> <script type="text/javascript" src="https://upholdbrilliancerecast.com/f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2/invoke.js"></script> </div> <div class="article-body" style="font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8; color: #333;"> <p>Whether you like to enjoy it between a couple of slices of bread, spread it on crackers, or eat it on its own with a spoon, tuna salad is an easy dish to prepare that makes use of kitchen staples. Despite its popularity and the many ways you can take tuna salad to the next level, though, many recipes include the same condiment to give it richness: mayonnaise. Sure, there are different brands that each have their own unique characteristics — but what do you do when you want to switch things up without losing out on the creamy mouthfeel? Try using crème fraîche.</p> <p>This rich product originated in France, and its name literally translates to "fresh cream" in English, though don't let its name fool you. It's actually a fermented dairy product made from cream, which makes it similar to but different from sour cream. For starters, it has a higher fat content, giving it a deliciously luscious consistency that complements the texture of the tuna well. It's also less acidic than sour cream, whose tanginess might not play well with every type of ingredient you want to add to your recipe. Furthermore, crème fraîche typically doesn't have added thickeners or stabilizers, which some consumers may want to avoid. It also has its own unique flavor that's slightly nutty and just a little sweet.</p> <p>Nevertheless, it can be pricier than sour cream, with an 8-ounce container of the former sometimes costing as much as twice the price of a 16-ounce container of the latter. However, you can transform sour cream into crème fraîche at home with some heavy cream.</p> <p>The first question you may have about using crème fraîche in tuna salad is how much you should use. If you're using one 5-ounce can of fish, add about a quarter cup of the rich, cultured cream to begin with, give it a stir, and add more if you prefer a creamier salad. Because crème fraîche has a high fat content, you'll want to use tuna packed in water rather than oil to prevent your finished dish from becoming too greasy.</p> <p>Beyond salt and pepper, there are several additions that will take the finished dish to the next level. Grainy mustard can offset the richness of the crème fraîche, along with some capers and finely chopped shallots. For a kick, you can also add a small amount of prepared horseradish or a few dashes of hot sauce. Chopped fresh parsley will impart freshness, and a squeeze of lemon juice can easily brighten the whole preparation.</p> <p>Crème fraîche isn't the only thing that will give your tuna salad a creamy mouthfeel and rich flavor, though. If you like a little extra tanginess and want to save money, sour cream may be a perfect base for an Eastern European-inspired tuna salad with dill and chopped pickles. You can also use Mexican-style crema, which is a little milder than sour cream but tangier than crème fraîche and pairs beautifully with chopped jalapeños. If you want something significantly milder, though, mascarpone is an excellent option and lets you get really creative with your seasonings and add-ins, as it won't compete with any of the elements of your recipe.</p> <p style="margin-top: 25px;"> <a href="https://www.foodrepublic.com/2312328/not-mayo-yogurt-give-tuna-salad-flavor-boost-creamy-ingredient-creme-fraiche/" target="_blank" rel="nofollow noopener" style="color: #0d6efd; text-decoration: none; font-weight: bold;"> → Baca artikel asli </a> </p> </div> <div style="text-align:center; margin:20px 0;"> <script type="text/javascript"> atOptions = {'key' : 'f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2','format' : 'iframe','height' : 90,'width' : 728,'params' : {}}; </script> <script type="text/javascript" src="https://upholdbrilliancerecast.com/f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2/invoke.js"></script> </div> </div> </article> <article class="article-card" id="artikel-9576"> <h2>#9576. Trainn MCP</h2> <div class="article-body"> <div style="text-align:center; margin:20px 0;"> <script type="text/javascript"> atOptions = {'key' : 'f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2','format' : 'iframe','height' : 90,'width' : 728,'params' : {}}; </script> <script type="text/javascript" src="https://upholdbrilliancerecast.com/f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2/invoke.js"></script> </div> </div> </article> <article class="article-card" id="artikel-9575"> <h2>#9575. 19 non-traditional Thanksgiving desserts that aren't pie : Cakes, cookies, and even a tiramisu for your holiday dessert table.</h2> <div class="article-body"> <div style="text-align:center; margin-bottom:20px;"><img src="https://www.kingarthurbaking.com/sites/default/files/2026-07/Apple-Crumb-Cake_BOTW_2026_Macro_H_18465.jpg" alt="19 non-traditional Thanksgiving desserts that aren't pie : Cakes, cookies, and even a tiramisu for your holiday dessert table." style="max-width:100%; height:auto; border-radius:8px;" loading="lazy"></div> <div style="text-align:center; margin:20px 0;"> <script type="text/javascript"> atOptions = {'key' : 'f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2','format' : 'iframe','height' : 90,'width' : 728,'params' : {}}; </script> <script type="text/javascript" src="https://upholdbrilliancerecast.com/f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2/invoke.js"></script> </div> <div class="article-body" style="font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8; color: #333;"> <p>Yes, Thanksgiving is a pie-centric holiday. But what if you don’t like pie? Or maybe you just don’t want it. Either way, we’ve got lots of non-pie Thanksgiving desserts, from spiced pumpkin cupcakes to sugary apple cobblers, plus plenty of autumnal cakes.</p> <p>This adorable cake pulls double duty, serving as both a scene-stealing centerpiece and a feast-ending dessert. To make, stack two mini Bundt cakes together and frost with orange buttercream. Carving this frosted pumpkin at the end of the meal may just upstage the turkey!</p> <p>Get the recipe: The Great Pumpkin Bundt Cake</p> <p>To make this recipe, you’ll need: Mini Bundt Pan Set</p> <p>This dessert demonstrates how to dress up a crumb cake for fall: Top velvety sour cream cake with a juicy layer of apples, then crown the cake with a generous layer of apple pie-spiced streusel.</p> <p>To make this recipe, you'll need: Instant Clearjel</p> <p>Cranberry sauce can be a polarizing side dish, but everyone will love this New England-inspired cake, which pairs tart cranberries with walnuts and vanilla for a simple, satisfying dessert. (Because it’s so quick to make, this is a particularly good recipe for any last-minute holiday baking.)</p> <p>To make this recipe, you’ll need: Sparkling Sugar</p> <p>Sweet potatoes belong on the dessert table, and this recipe proves it. This ultra-soft cake is gently spiced and glows orange from the sweet potato purée, and it’s finished with a fluffy meringue that mimics marshmallow-topped sweet potato casseroles.</p> <p>Get the recipe: Sweet Potato Sheet Cake with Marshmallow Frosting (make it gluten-free with Measure for Measure Flour)</p> <p>To make this recipe, you’ll need: 9” x 13” pan</p> <p>For a dessert that’s rich but not too sweet, turn to this recipe, which pairs pumpkin and pumpkin spice with chocolate chips. Baked in a decorative Bundt pan, it can be served unfrosted for an easy-yet-elegant dessert.</p> <p>Get the recipe: Pumpkin-Chocolate Chip Cake</p> <p>To make this recipe, you’ll need: Soft Swirl Bundt Pan</p> <p>Instead of apple pie, try an apple pan dowdy on your Thanksgiving dessert table. The pan dowdy is a traditional American dish from the 1800s and early 1900s. A combination of pie and pudding, the name comes from the method in which the recipe is completed: After an apple-based filling is baked in a crust-lined casserole, the baker takes a fork and "dowdies" the crust, breaking it into pieces that remain crisp despite being partially immersed in the juicy filling.</p> <p>To make this recipe, you’ll need: 9" square pan</p> <p>“Thanksgiving cheesecake” may not have quite the same ring as “Thanksgiving pie,” but when your guests are eating this ultra-creamy dessert, they won’t care. With its burnished top and custardy interior, this Pumpkin Basque Cheesecake reimagines the classic with bold autumnal flair, thanks to golden pumpkin purée and warm spices.</p> <p>Get the recipe: Pumpkin Basque Cheesecake</p> <p>To make this recipe, you’ll need: Pumpkin Pie Spice</p> <p>Don’t be fooled by its stodgy name or humble appearance: This cake is so good, we named it our #1 best fall recipe! In fact, my colleague Jessica Battilana made it for Thanksgiving last year and declared it the biggest hit of the day; her guests fell in love with the moist, apple-loaded cake and fudgy brown sugar frosting.</p> <p>Get the recipe: Old-Fashioned Apple Cake with Brown Sugar Frosting</p> <p>To make this recipe, you’ll need: Vermont Boiled Cider</p> <p>If your biggest complaint about PSLs is that there's not enough coffee flavor, look to this Bundt cake, which has an espresso powder swirl running through the tender pumpkin crumb and a coffee glaze to finish the whole thing off.</p> <p>Get the recipe: Pumpkin Espresso Bundt Cake</p> <p>To make this recipe, you'll need: Golden Wheat Flour</p> <p>If you don’t want to fuss with pie, we suggest making a cobbler instead. This fruit-filled version pairs juicy spiced apples with a crackly brown sugar crust — both prep and serving are easy, and the resulting cobbler will absolutely steal the show.</p> <p>Get the recipe: Sugar-Crusted Apple Cobbler</p> <p>To make this recipe, you’ll need: Vietnamese Cinnamon</p> <p>Apples are great, but seasonal pears deserve some love too. This simple cake, made with a combination of almond and all-purpose flours, has a rich, buttery texture and an almost marzipan-like chew. Studded with fragrant cubes of ripe pear, it's an elegant after-dinner dessert.</p> <p>To make this recipe, you’ll need: Almond Flour</p> <p>The boozy Bundt cake features potent maple flavor thanks to the 1/2 cup (!) of maple syrup in the batter, plus the sticky maple-and-rum glaze to finish. Made with cake flour and sour cream, the cake itself is dense and velvety, like all great pound cakes should be.</p> <p>Get the recipe: Maple Pound Cake with Maple-Rum Glaze</p> <p>To make this recipe, you’ll need: Vermont Maple Syrup and Natural Maple Flavor</p> <p>Instead of slicing and serving dessert, bake every guest their own individual mini cake. Start with a moist, spicy sheet cake, then use a biscuit cutter or overturned glass to cut rounds for individual layer cakes sandwiched with cream cheese frosting.</p> <p>To make this recipe, you’ll need: Apple Pie Spice</p> <p>Rich, silky, and balanced, this cheesecake is the kind of dessert that wins people (even cheesecake skeptics) over at first bite. Pecans are blended into the crust to add a subtle nutty flavor and delicate crunch. The ultra-creamy filling gets its sweetness from brown sugar and maple syrup, while heavy cream gives it an especially luxurious texture.</p> <p>To make this recipe, you’ll need: Maple Syrup</p> <p>To make this recipe, you’ll need: Pumpkin Pie Spice</p> <p>For a little French flair at your Thanksgiving table, make this classic tarte tatin. This dessert can be a little fussy, but we’ve endlessly tested our version to make sure it goes off without a hitch in your kitchen. And it’s worth it for the deeply caramelized apples layered over shattering pastry.</p> <p>Get the recipe: Classic Apple Tarte Tatin</p> <p>To make this recipe, you’ll need: 9” round cake pan</p> <p>Tiramisu gets a fall-forward spin in this coffeeshop-inspired dessert. Just like a caramel macchiato combines espresso, steamed milk, and a generous caramel drizzle, this twist on classic tiramisu layers salted caramel sauce between espresso-soaked ladyfingers and mascarpone filling.</p> <p>Get the recipe: Caramel Macchiato Tiramisu</p> <p>To make this recipe, you’ll need: Espresso Powder</p> <p>Make serving Thanksgiving dessert a breeze by baking up a big batch of cupcakes. These are packed with pumpkin flavor and spice, then finished with an easy swoop of cream cheese frosting. If you really want to level up your presentation, check out these cupcake decorating techniques for a pro-level finish.</p> <p>Get the recipe: Pumpkin Cupcakes (make them gluten-free with Measure for Measure Flour)</p> <p>To make this recipe, you’ll need: Unbleached Cake Flour</p> <p>This holiday-ready version of our five-star Everyday Olive Oil Cake is adorned with a big red bow in the form of a simple but stunning cranberry glaze. Made by cooking cranberries with orange juice, then whisking the mixture with confectioners’ sugar, the icing adds a bright tartness that complements the rich cake.</p> <p>Get the recipe: Cranberry-Orange Olive Oil Cake</p> <p>To make this recipe, you’ll need: King Arthur Square Pan</p> <p>Find everything you need for a successful holiday meal in our Thanksgiving Survival Guide.</p> <p>Cover photo by Patrick Marinello; food styling by Yekaterina Boytsova.</p> <p>Top tips from the Things Bakers Know podcast.</p> <p>Mini pies may be the secret to a stress-free celebration.</p> <p>See our complete collection of Recipes posts.</p> <p>Desserts that may just upstage the feast.</p> <p>Because dinner rolls are a non-negotiable side dish.</p> <p>Facebook TikTok Instagram Threads Pinterest LinkedIn YouTube Reddit Substack</p> <p style="margin-top: 25px;"> <a href="https://www.kingarthurbaking.com/blog/2026/10/02/non-traditional-thanksgiving-desserts" target="_blank" rel="nofollow noopener" style="color: #0d6efd; text-decoration: none; font-weight: bold;"> → Baca artikel asli </a> </p> </div> <div style="text-align:center; margin:20px 0;"> <script type="text/javascript"> atOptions = {'key' : 'f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2','format' : 'iframe','height' : 90,'width' : 728,'params' : {}}; </script> <script type="text/javascript" src="https://upholdbrilliancerecast.com/f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2/invoke.js"></script> </div> </div> </article> <article class="article-card" id="artikel-9574"> <h2>#9574. 9 Ranch Dressing Brands With High-Quality Ingredients</h2> <div class="article-body"> <div style="text-align:center; margin-bottom:20px;"><img src="https://www.foodrepublic.com/img/gallery/9-ranch-dressing-brands-with-high-quality-ingredients/l-intro-1794288261.jpg" alt="9 Ranch Dressing Brands With High-Quality Ingredients" style="max-width:100%; height:auto; border-radius:8px;" loading="lazy"></div> <div style="text-align:center; margin:20px 0;"> <script type="text/javascript"> atOptions = {'key' : 'f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2','format' : 'iframe','height' : 90,'width' : 728,'params' : {}}; </script> <script type="text/javascript" src="https://upholdbrilliancerecast.com/f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2/invoke.js"></script> </div> <div class="article-body" style="font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8; color: #333;"> <p>We may receive a commission on purchases made from links.</p> <p>Ranch is one of the most popular salad dressings and dips in the country. But many of the tangy products are made with less-than-ideal ingredients. That's why we've created this list of organic and clean-ingredient ranch brands. Not only do dressings with high-quality ingredients generally taste better due to the lack of fillers, but they're healthier, too. That's thanks to the products being made without artificial ingredients or synthetic preservatives. The fact that you can use less and still get a lot of flavor makes these an economical choice, as well.</p> <p>Because these brands use minimal stabilizers and preservatives, it's important to know they won't last as long as other shelf-stable ranch dressings. Usually, a bottle of ranch can stay safe for up to three months after opening, but with these companies' products often using real dairy, it's best to treat them more like homemade. That means it's safest to consume these dressings within one month of opening, although some can last up to two months. But with all the different ways you can use ranch, leftovers shouldn't be a problem.</p> <p>Primal Kitchen was founded in 2015 as a way to bring clean-ingredient condiments to the public. Today, it sells over 80 products, such as organic unsweetened ketchup, steak sauce, and mayonnaise made with avocado oil. The company uses plant-based oils and other high-quality ingredients in its ranch, which has no added sugars or conventional stabilizers. Primal Kitchen Ranch, which can be found in many grocery stores, is also made with cage-free eggs, is certified Keto-safe and gluten-free, and is Whole30 approved.</p> <p>This product is dairy-free, relying on a mix of organic apple cider vinegar, spices, herbs, and egg yolks to create the rich, tangy taste of ranch. Mushroom extract takes the place of synthetic preservatives to keep the dressing fresh, and the dip's base is made from avocado oil-based mayo. In fact, many of Primal Kitchen's dressings and sauces contain avocado oil because it's a sustainable source of monounsaturated fats that are linked to lowering "bad" LDL cholesterol and reducing blood pressure.</p> <p>Reviewers have reported the sauce having a distinctly herby taste, with pronounced dill that wasn't overwhelming. The dressing is great as is, but feel free to add a bit of lime to turn the ranch into the base for incredible nachos. Or if you want an unexpectedly delicious flavor, add some edible lavender to the dip. The aromatic flower complements the heavier sauce and makes this a wonderful addition to a chopped veggies board.</p> <p>Ohio-based slaw and salad dressing company Marzetti was founded way back in 1896. Today, it's respected enough by customers to have ranked No. 32 in the Food and Beverage section on Newsweek's list of the Most Trustworthy Companies in America in 2026. So it's probably not surprising to learn that Marzetti has earned not just one, but two spots on this list.</p> <p>This first one is for the Classic Ranch Dressing. This product is made without artificial flavors, preservatives, or high fructose corn syrup. It also uses actual buttermilk instead of powder, giving it an authentic tangy taste and a creamy consistency. The brand sells it in a refrigerated 13-ounce option or as a 22-ounce shelf-stable bottle. Fans of the classic ranch have praised the product's taste and versatility, alongside the fact that the larger version comes in a squeeze bottle, allowing them to easily portion out exactly how much they'd like.</p> <p>Created by a woman who wanted to ensure the dressing she was using was healthy, Tessemae's makes its products without artificial ingredients, and every ranch in its line of six is Whole30-approved and made without any elements harvested from genetically modified organisms (GMOs). The company's Organic Creamy Ranch Dressing & Dip doesn't have any fillers either; plus it's gluten- and dairy-free, as well as certified USDA organic.</p> <p>The sauce uses cage-free eggs in the base, alongside organic high oleic sunflower oil, lemon juice, and mustard. This results in a thick, luscious mix that's flavored by various spices and herbs, with tanginess from distilled vinegar. The plant-based dressing is suitable for those following a keto or vegetarian lifestyle. And even though this version is different from the original 1950s ranch recipe, it's still great for marinating fried chicken, serving as a dip for pizza, or simply pouring on salad greens.</p> <p>Walden Farms is so dedicated to customer satisfaction that the company changed the way it makes its dressings. After hearing people ask for cleaner ingredients, it reformulated the recipes it uses for products like the Ranch Dressing. The dip is now made with olive oil and no artificial flavors. It's also gluten-free and low-calorie, so it can appeal to a wider audience.</p> <p>The ranch is low-carb, too, with only 1 gram per serving. Being plant-based, it's suitable for vegetarian lifestyles, and it's still made with no sugars, so it's friendly for diabetic people, as well. There are 30 calories per serving, and the olive oil base ensures this dressing only has three grams of total fat in each portion. If you're interested in trying Walden Farms ranch, you can use it in your next batch of mac and cheese along with corn kernels for some nice pops of sweetness.</p> <p>Drew's Organics doesn't use GMO ingredients or any artificial flavors or colors in any of its dressings. That includes the Creamy Ranch Dressing & Quick Marinade, which is made without artificial preservatives, added sugars, high-fructose corn syrup, or trans fats. The ranch dressing also works as a great marinade for a juicy pork roast or chicken, thanks to its combination of fat, sodium, and vinegars. In fact, reviewers have noted the ranch has a wonderfully oniony taste, with a thick enough texture to stick to a salad or side of fries.</p> <p>It's also made with organic high oleic sunflower oil, which is a heart-healthy alternative to heavier fats, thanks to being high in monounsaturated fatty acids. These MUFAs are associated with lowering insulin resistance, inflammation, and cardiovascular diseases, according to research published in the Annals of Clinical Nutrition and Metabolism. If this is your first time encountering it, high-oleic oil acts like extra virgin olive oil when cooking because the two have very similar fat amounts and types.</p> <p>Toby's Family Foods has been around since 1978. The company specializes in making each of its eight dressings in batches small enough that every one of them can still be made by hand. There are regular sauces, as well as probiotic ones, including a ranch made with yogurt as a base. Toby's regular Ranch Dressing & Dip is made with clean ingredients, such as buttermilk from cows that aren't given rBST, a synthetic growth hormone that's been linked to certain forms of cancer.</p> <p>The ranch doesn't use artificial flavors, preservatives, MSG, or synthetic stabilizers, so it has a shorter refrigeration window after opening. Instead of one to two months, Toby's recommends the sauce be finished within two weeks. It also uses non-GMO canola oil that's obtained through high-pressure processing to keep as many of the vitamins and flavor intact as possible. That oil can sometimes separate from the dairy in the ranch, but all you have to do to recombine it is shake or stir the bottle's contents a bit.</p> <p>Briannas has a long line of dressings and sauces made with high-quality ingredients. The brand's Traditional Ranch is a newer product that, while similar to its Classic Buttermilk Ranch, has fewer calories per serving. This option is also gluten-free, vegetarian, and Kosher Certified.</p> <p>It's made without high-fructose corn syrup, which many companies use as a cheaper alternative to natural sugars. However, large amounts of high-fructose corn syrup have been linked to liver inflammation, making it something you might want to steer clear of in general. Made in Brenham, Texas, Briannas ranch doesn't have trans fats and is manufactured in a facility without the potential for cross-contamination from nuts.</p> <p>The company has such a dedication to sustainability that each part of the ranch's (or any other dressing's) bottle can be recycled. That includes the label and cap liner. And to be sure the products meet the brand's high-quality standards, the facility is certified by the SQF, or Safe Quality Food, Institute, which evaluates a business according to strict food manufacturing requirements.</p> <p>Those who follow vegetarian or vegan lifestyles can be assured there's a ranch for them here, too. Follow Your Heart has been focused on creating intentionally wholesome foods since 1970, which is why the company's Vegan Ranch Dressing is Certified Plant-Based and made without GMO ingredients. It's also gluten-free, thanks to ingredients like xanthan gum, which takes over for gluten in helping the product bind and thicken while keeping it stabilized. The ranch is low in sodium, too, so those watching their salt intake can still enjoy the dressing.</p> <p>The sauce is reported by fans to be a thick, creamy, and highly versatile addition to a snack or meal. One person even claimed that they could eat the dip by itself. An Amazon reviewer said, "This vegan version of Ranch dressing is stupendous and I am re-ordering it. I cannot add enough superlatives to describe just how good it is."</p> <p>Marzetti's second entry is from its Simply Dressed line, which was launched in March 2026. Coming from a company that's well over a century old, it's not surprising these new products have already gotten good reviews for taste and consistency.</p> <p>Sauces in this line, like the Homestyle Ranch Dressing & Dip, are made with both canola and extra virgin olive oils. This means it has no trans fats, which is better for customers' long-term heart health. The dressing is also safe for those leading vegetarian lifestyles.</p> <p>Like the classic ranch, it's made without high fructose corn syrup, preservatives, and artificial colors or flavors. But the Simply Dressed version has fewer calories per serving and is gluten-free. Shoppers can use the sauce as a dip on its own, or it can be combined with a bit of sour cream or a soft cheese to make it thicker and add even more creamy texture.</p> <p>Determining the ranch dressing brands with the cleanest ingredients was an interesting task to tackle. We first searched for clean-ingredient and organic brands that made ranch dressing before making a list of the dips and sauces that met our high standards. The dressings had to be made without artificial ingredients, minimally processed, and free of synthetic preservatives to make it onto the final list presented here.</p> <p style="margin-top: 25px;"> <a href="https://www.foodrepublic.com/2311796/ranch-dressing-brands-high-quality-ingredients/" target="_blank" rel="nofollow noopener" style="color: #0d6efd; text-decoration: none; font-weight: bold;"> → Baca artikel asli </a> </p> </div> <div style="text-align:center; margin:20px 0;"> <script type="text/javascript"> atOptions = {'key' : 'f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2','format' : 'iframe','height' : 90,'width' : 728,'params' : {}}; </script> <script type="text/javascript" src="https://upholdbrilliancerecast.com/f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2/invoke.js"></script> </div> </div> </article> <article class="article-card" id="artikel-9573"> <h2>#9573. This Thanksgiving, make your pies mini: Mini pies may be the secret to a stress-free celebration.</h2> <div class="article-body"> <div style="text-align:center; margin-bottom:20px;"><img src="https://www.kingarthurbaking.com/sites/default/files/2026-09/Mini-Apple-Pies_2026_Graphic_H_2990.jpg" alt="This Thanksgiving, make your pies mini: Mini pies may be the secret to a stress-free celebration." style="max-width:100%; height:auto; border-radius:8px;" loading="lazy"></div> <div style="text-align:center; margin:20px 0;"> <script type="text/javascript"> atOptions = {'key' : 'f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2','format' : 'iframe','height' : 90,'width' : 728,'params' : {}}; </script> <script type="text/javascript" src="https://upholdbrilliancerecast.com/f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2/invoke.js"></script> </div> <div class="article-body" style="font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8; color: #333;"> <p>What’s the one food you most look forward to at Thanksgiving?</p> <p>For some it’s the turkey. For others it’s the array of sides. But for many of us bakers, let’s admit it — our thoughts skip right over the apps and main meal and go straight to the pies, whether it's apple, pumpkin, pecan, or all of them together.</p> <p>The problem is that for smaller gatherings, the need for multiple pies diminishes. Still, how can you bear to choose between apple, pumpkin, and pecan?</p> <p>Enter the mini pie, a great way to showcase an array of pies and have them all disappear by the end of the day.</p> <p>Here’s a potential hosting scenario this year: You’re serving six close family members (including yourself) at Thanksgiving dinner; you want to offer pumpkin, apple, and pecan pie. So you pull out your mini muffin pan and use it to make mini pies in a variety of different flavors. Everyone can enjoy one mini pie immediately, one later, and squirrel one away for the next day.</p> <p>And mini pies aren't just handy for smaller gatherings — they can also make life a little easier during the frenetic rush of food prep in the days before Turkey Day. Helpfully, you can make these pies well ahead of Thanksgiving; they can be prepared, baked, and then frozen for up to a few weeks before serving.</p> <p>Once cool, wrap each pie individually in plastic, then bag them all airtight and freeze. When you’re ready to serve, unwrap, thaw, and reheat briefly: 5 to 10 minutes in a 350°F oven or about 20 seconds (per pie) in a microwave will bring them back to life.</p> <p>Because these mini pies have a higher crust-to-filling ratio, you don't need to prebake the crust to avoid a soggy bottom. Just place the pie dough rounds in your mini muffin pan, fill with about a tablespoon of the pumpkin custard, and bake.</p> <p>Another benefit: The smaller amount of filling makes it easier to nail the bake. You don't have to look for a perfect amount of jiggle in your pie before removing from the oven — just bake until the exposed edges are golden brown and the custard is set in the center.</p> <p>Turn to our Pecan Tassies recipe — a beloved Southern dessert, pecan tassies are basically just bite-size pecan pies. This recipe uses a tender, unsweetened cream cheese pastry, which cradles a gooey nut filling sweetened with brown sugar (no corn syrup).</p> <p>We’ve saved perhaps the most beloved pie for last: apple. These mini apple pies are a bit more involved than the pumpkin or pecan pies. You need to precook the filling, and you have to choose how to top them. That said, they’re totally worth the effort (and the filling can be prepared up to five days in advance; store the cooled filling, covered, in the refrigerator until ready to bake).</p> <p>Once you've precooked the diced apple filling on the stovetop to remove excess liquid, assemble your pies in your mini muffin pan by lining with rounds of pie dough and adding the apples. You can then choose how to top them:</p> <p>You may be questioning whether making mini Thanksgiving pies is more trouble than it's worth. But helpfully, the techniques involved are very approachable — mix, roll, fill, bake — and the resulting pies are both delicious and just plain fun. Have you ever wanted a whole Thanksgiving pie just for yourself? You can have it — in miniature. Happy baking!</p> <p>Do you say you won't dare bake pie because you're unsure of your skills with a rolling pin? Check out these other easy no-roll crusts: No-Roll Pie Crust and Graham Cracker Crust.</p> <p>Cover photo by Patrick Marinello; food styling by Kaitlin Wayne. Additional contributions from PJ Hamel.</p> <p>Top tips from the Things Bakers Know podcast.</p> <p>See our complete collection of Recipes posts.</p> <p>Top tips from the Things Bakers Know podcast.</p> <p>Because dinner rolls are a non-negotiable side dish.</p> <p>Facebook TikTok Instagram Threads Pinterest LinkedIn YouTube Reddit Substack</p> <p style="margin-top: 25px;"> <a href="https://www.kingarthurbaking.com/blog/2026/11/04/mini-Thanksgiving-pies" target="_blank" rel="nofollow noopener" style="color: #0d6efd; text-decoration: none; font-weight: bold;"> → Baca artikel asli </a> </p> </div> <div style="text-align:center; margin:20px 0;"> <script type="text/javascript"> atOptions = {'key' : 'f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2','format' : 'iframe','height' : 90,'width' : 728,'params' : {}}; </script> <script type="text/javascript" src="https://upholdbrilliancerecast.com/f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2/invoke.js"></script> </div> </div> </article> <article class="article-card" id="artikel-9572"> <h2>#9572. Chicken Tortilla Soup</h2> <div class="article-body"> <div style="text-align:center; margin:20px 0;"> <script type="text/javascript"> atOptions = {'key' : 'f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2','format' : 'iframe','height' : 90,'width' : 728,'params' : {}}; </script> <script type="text/javascript" src="https://upholdbrilliancerecast.com/f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2/invoke.js"></script> </div> <div class="article-body" style="font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8; color: #333;"> <p>Chicken Tortilla Soup Ingredients A few notes about what you’ll need for this soup: How To Make Chicken Tortilla Soup…</p> <p style="margin-top: 25px;"> <a href="https://www.gimmesomeoven.com/chicken-tortilla-soup-recipe/" target="_blank" rel="nofollow noopener" style="color: #0d6efd; text-decoration: none; font-weight: bold;"> → Baca artikel asli </a> </p> </div> <div style="text-align:center; margin:20px 0;"> <script type="text/javascript"> atOptions = {'key' : 'f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2','format' : 'iframe','height' : 90,'width' : 728,'params' : {}}; </script> <script type="text/javascript" src="https://upholdbrilliancerecast.com/f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2/invoke.js"></script> </div> </div> </article> <article class="article-card" id="artikel-9571"> <h2>#9571. Not Regular Butter Or Mayo: Use This Spread To Give Breakfast Burritos A Delicious, Crunchy Exterior</h2> <div class="article-body"> <div style="text-align:center; margin-bottom:20px;"><img src="https://www.foodrepublic.com/img/gallery/not-regular-butter-or-mayo-use-this-spread-to-give-breakfast-burritos-a-delicious-crunchy-exterior/l-intro-1794338265.jpg" alt="Not Regular Butter Or Mayo: Use This Spread To Give Breakfast Burritos A Delicious, Crunchy Exterior" style="max-width:100%; height:auto; border-radius:8px;" loading="lazy"></div> <div style="text-align:center; margin:20px 0;"> <script type="text/javascript"> atOptions = {'key' : 'f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2','format' : 'iframe','height' : 90,'width' : 728,'params' : {}}; </script> <script type="text/javascript" src="https://upholdbrilliancerecast.com/f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2/invoke.js"></script> </div> <div class="article-body" style="font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8; color: #333;"> <p>Breakfast burritos originated in Santa Fe, New Mexico, and have now become a popular way to start the day across the U.S. — they are even available at McDonald's! The typical combination of eggs, meats, and cheese wrapped in a tortilla is not only packed with flavor and protein but is also a conveniently portable food.</p> <p>There are many variations on a breakfast burrito recipe, such as changing up the type of cheese or switching up the meats, but these ignore what holds it all together: the tortilla. You can just wrap your fillings in one and call it a day, but you know that it's much better (and crunchier) when you toast it, and you need a little fat to get the job done. Butter is a great solution, but using garlic butter will impart so much additional flavor to your finished breakfast burrito.</p> <p>Garlic butter isn't some type of fat made from garlic, though. Instead, it's part of a larger category of foods called compound butters, which consist of regular dairy butter blended with a variety of seasonings and other ingredients to add flavor. Since many herbs and spices contain fat-soluble flavor compounds, the butter becomes infused with the aromas of whatever is added to it, including garlic. So, when you toast your breakfast burrito in garlic butter, the fat itself has a garlicky kick that will get transferred to your tortilla. It will also save you the hassle of frying garlic in butter to get a similar effect.</p> <p>To make your breakfast burrito extra crispy with garlic butter, you simply need to wrap your burrito in a flour tortilla, which is the most flexible for making this breakfast favorite and tends to come in larger sizes compared to corn tortillas. You can assemble several burritos this way if you want to meal prep. Then, melt about a tablespoon of garlic butter in a pan over medium heat and place your burrito in the pan seam-side down to seal it. Turn it over to toast the other side, and promptly remove it from the pan. For more even browning, you can place a flat tortilla in the pan, add all your fillings, and then remove it to roll up, making sure to tuck in the sides. You can also grease a muffin tin with garlic butter to make breakfast burrito bites.</p> <p>There are many commercially available garlic butters you can find at supermarkets, including one made by Kerrygold, but they can often be more expensive per ounce than regular butter, even from premium brands. Fortunately, compound butters — including variations on plain garlic butter — are very easy to make at home. David Guas' roasted garlic compound butter, for example, can be frozen for up to three months and is customizable. You can add finely minced herbs, like parsley and thyme. If you don't have fresh herbs, you can also use dried versions, though give your compound butter some extra time for the flavors to marry.</p> <p style="margin-top: 25px;"> <a href="https://www.foodrepublic.com/2312489/not-regular-butter-mayo-spread-give-breakfast-burrito-crunchy-exterior/" target="_blank" rel="nofollow noopener" style="color: #0d6efd; text-decoration: none; font-weight: bold;"> → Baca artikel asli </a> </p> </div> <div style="text-align:center; margin:20px 0;"> <script type="text/javascript"> atOptions = {'key' : 'f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2','format' : 'iframe','height' : 90,'width' : 728,'params' : {}}; </script> <script type="text/javascript" src="https://upholdbrilliancerecast.com/f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2/invoke.js"></script> </div> </div> </article> <article class="article-card" id="artikel-9570"> <h2>#9570. Falafel</h2> <div class="article-body"> <div style="text-align:center; margin:20px 0;"> <script type="text/javascript"> atOptions = {'key' : 'f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2','format' : 'iframe','height' : 90,'width' : 728,'params' : {}}; </script> <script type="text/javascript" src="https://upholdbrilliancerecast.com/f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2/invoke.js"></script> </div> <div class="article-body" style="font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8; color: #333;"> <p>Crispy homemade falafel made with dried chickpeas, fresh herbs, lemon and warm spices. Serve with tahini sauce, pita and crunchy vegetables.</p> <p style="margin-top: 25px;"> <a href="https://www.gimmesomeoven.com/falafel-recipe/" target="_blank" rel="nofollow noopener" style="color: #0d6efd; text-decoration: none; font-weight: bold;"> → Baca artikel asli </a> </p> </div> <div style="text-align:center; margin:20px 0;"> <script type="text/javascript"> atOptions = {'key' : 'f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2','format' : 'iframe','height' : 90,'width' : 728,'params' : {}}; </script> <script type="text/javascript" src="https://upholdbrilliancerecast.com/f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2/invoke.js"></script> </div> </div> </article> <article class="article-card" id="artikel-9569"> <h2>#9569. What Narcissists, Psychopaths And Sadists Have In Common</h2> <div class="article-body"> <div style="text-align:center; margin-bottom:20px;"><img src="https://www.spring.org.uk/images/psychopath-6.jpg" alt="What Narcissists, Psychopaths And Sadists Have In Common" style="max-width:100%; height:auto; border-radius:8px;" loading="lazy"></div> <div style="text-align:center; margin:20px 0;"> <script type="text/javascript"> atOptions = {'key' : 'f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2','format' : 'iframe','height' : 90,'width' : 728,'params' : {}}; </script> <script type="text/javascript" src="https://upholdbrilliancerecast.com/f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2/invoke.js"></script> </div> <div class="article-body" style="font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8; color: #333;"> <p>Different dark personalities may have more in common than their labels suggest.</p> <p>Different dark personalities may have more in common than their labels suggest.</p> <p>Narcissists, psychopaths, sadists and manipulative people share a dark personality core that predicts selfish and antisocial choices.</p> <p>This common tendency helps explain whether people exploit others, retaliate against them or refuse to trust them.</p> <p>The crucial feature is a willingness to pursue personal interests at other people’s expense, accompanied by beliefs that justify doing so.</p> <p>Known as the dark factor of personality, or D, this tendency brings together traits that can look quite different on the surface.</p> <p>Narcissism involves an inflated sense of self-importance, Machiavellianism centres on manipulation, psychopathy includes callousness, and sadism involves enjoying others’ suffering.</p> <p>The idea that these traits share an underlying disposition was established in earlier research examining their overlap and links to harmful behaviour (Moshagen et al., 2018).</p> <p>The latest findings suggest that this shared core is more consistently associated with antisocial decisions than any of the four traits considered separately.</p> <p>In other words, knowing what these personalities have in common may reveal more about their choices than knowing which particular label fits them.</p> <p>The research involved over 10,000 people across ten studies using eight types of decision-making game.</p> <p>Participants completed personality questionnaires before making hypothetical choices involving another person they did not know.</p> <p>Depending on the game, they could decide how much money to share, whether to return someone’s trust, whether to retaliate or whether to cooperate.</p> <p>Some situations allowed people to benefit themselves at someone else’s expense, while others explored whether they would trust another person when cooperation could benefit both.</p> <p>People scoring higher on the dark factor consistently made fewer prosocial choices across all eight games.</p> <p>The individual dark traits also generally predicted less prosocial behaviour, but their associations were weaker.</p> <p>Once their shared dark core was taken into account, the separate traits usually added little to the explanation.</p> <p>There were a few exceptions, particularly involving Machiavellianism in situations where distrust could influence decisions.</p> <p>One possible explanation is that dark personality traits combine harmful tendencies with other characteristics that are not inherently antisocial.</p> <p>For example, boldness does not necessarily involve harming anyone, while wanting admiration does not automatically mean exploiting others.</p> <p>Earlier research proposed that these additional characteristics help distinguish dark traits from one another, while their shared core captures what makes them socially harmful (Bader et al., 2023).</p> <p>Measuring a broad trait such as psychopathy may therefore mix callous self-interest with features that have little relevance to a particular moral decision.</p> <p>Focusing on the common core could provide a clearer picture of someone’s willingness to disregard other people’s welfare.</p> <p>Importantly, the dark factor extends beyond wanting a larger share of the rewards.</p> <p>It also encompasses a readiness to hurt others and beliefs that can make selfish conduct seem acceptable.</p> <p>Distrust may fit this pattern because expecting other people to behave selfishly can provide a convenient justification for doing the same.</p> <p>That is a proposed psychological explanation, rather than evidence that distrust caused the choices observed here.</p> <p>The findings do not mean that everyone with dark traits will behave selfishly in every situation.</p> <p>Nor do they establish that personality caused the decisions participants made.</p> <p>All the games were hypothetical, so participants were describing what they would choose rather than making decisions with real financial consequences.</p> <p>This matters because associations between dark traits and antisocial choices can be stronger in hypothetical situations than when money is genuinely at stake.</p> <p>Participants also volunteered through a website offering dark-personality assessments, so they were not a representative sample of the wider population.</p> <p>Even with these qualifications, the results support a simpler account of apparently different dark personalities: much of their connection to harmful choices lies in the same underlying disregard for others.</p> <p>The study was published in the journal Judgment and Decision Making (Hilbig & Thielmann, 2025).</p> <p>Psychologist, Jeremy Dean, PhD is the founder and author of PsyBlog. He holds a doctorate in psychology from University College London and two other advanced degrees in psychology. He has been writing about scientific research on PsyBlog since 2004. View all posts by Dr Jeremy Dean</p> <p>Join the free PsyBlog mailing list. No spam, ever.</p> <p style="margin-top: 25px;"> <a href="https://www.spring.org.uk/2026/10/narcissists-psychopaths.php" target="_blank" rel="nofollow noopener" style="color: #0d6efd; text-decoration: none; font-weight: bold;"> → Baca artikel asli </a> </p> </div> <div style="text-align:center; margin:20px 0;"> <script type="text/javascript"> atOptions = {'key' : 'f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2','format' : 'iframe','height' : 90,'width' : 728,'params' : {}}; </script> <script type="text/javascript" src="https://upholdbrilliancerecast.com/f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2/invoke.js"></script> </div> </div> </article> <article class="article-card" id="artikel-9568"> <h2>#9568. The unexpected pan you need this holiday season : The case to make everything mini.</h2> <div class="article-body"> <div style="text-align:center; margin-bottom:20px;"><img src="https://www.kingarthurbaking.com/sites/default/files/2026-09/Mini-Apple-Pies_2026_INT_H_3030.jpg" alt="The unexpected pan you need this holiday season : The case to make everything mini." style="max-width:100%; height:auto; border-radius:8px;" loading="lazy"></div> <div style="text-align:center; margin:20px 0;"> <script type="text/javascript"> atOptions = {'key' : 'f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2','format' : 'iframe','height' : 90,'width' : 728,'params' : {}}; </script> <script type="text/javascript" src="https://upholdbrilliancerecast.com/f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2/invoke.js"></script> </div> <div class="article-body" style="font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8; color: #333;"> <p>Lining every well takes a little extra time, but the smaller format pays off: for these mini pumpkin pies and quiches, you can skip parbaking step and still get a crisp, flaky crust. Plus, they’re ready to serve out of the pan — no pie cutter required.</p> <p>Not feeling pie? Consider Molten Chocolate Mini Cakes instead. And when houseguests wake up, bring the pan back out for Mini Quiches or Protein Pancake Bites.</p> <p>Get the most out of this last month of fall baking with an oven-baked version of a fried favorite: warm apple cider doughnuts. Making and frying them from scratch can feel like more work than they’re worth, but a mini muffin pan offers an easier route. These Apple Cider Doughnut Holes are baked entirely in the oven, then tossed in butter, boiled cider, and spices and served warm for the same cozy appeal as a freshly fried doughnut.</p> <p>Cover photo (Mini Apple Pies) by Patrick Marinello; food styling by Kaitlin Wayne.</p> <p>Top tips from the Things Bakers Know podcast.</p> <p>Mini pies may be the secret to a stress-free celebration.</p> <p>See our complete collection of Tips and Techniques posts.</p> <p>Facebook TikTok Instagram Threads Pinterest LinkedIn YouTube Reddit Substack</p> <p style="margin-top: 25px;"> <a href="https://www.kingarthurbaking.com/blog/2026/11/09/mini-muffin-pan-recipes" target="_blank" rel="nofollow noopener" style="color: #0d6efd; text-decoration: none; font-weight: bold;"> → Baca artikel asli </a> </p> </div> <div style="text-align:center; margin:20px 0;"> <script type="text/javascript"> atOptions = {'key' : 'f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2','format' : 'iframe','height' : 90,'width' : 728,'params' : {}}; </script> <script type="text/javascript" src="https://upholdbrilliancerecast.com/f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2/invoke.js"></script> </div> </div> </article> <article class="article-card" id="artikel-9566"> <h2>#9566. Steak Tacos with Creamy Avocado Salsa Verde</h2> <div class="article-body"> <div style="text-align:center; margin:20px 0;"> <script type="text/javascript"> atOptions = {'key' : 'f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2','format' : 'iframe','height' : 90,'width' : 728,'params' : {}}; </script> <script type="text/javascript" src="https://upholdbrilliancerecast.com/f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2/invoke.js"></script> </div> <div class="article-body" style="font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8; color: #333;"> <p>Steak Taco Ingredients You’ll find the full ingredient amounts in the recipe card below, but here are a few quick…</p> <p style="margin-top: 25px;"> <a href="https://www.gimmesomeoven.com/steak-tacos-with-creamy-avocado-salsa-verde/" target="_blank" rel="nofollow noopener" style="color: #0d6efd; text-decoration: none; font-weight: bold;"> → Baca artikel asli </a> </p> </div> <div style="text-align:center; margin:20px 0;"> <script type="text/javascript"> atOptions = {'key' : 'f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2','format' : 'iframe','height' : 90,'width' : 728,'params' : {}}; </script> <script type="text/javascript" src="https://upholdbrilliancerecast.com/f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2/invoke.js"></script> </div> </div> </article> <article class="article-card" id="artikel-9565"> <h2>#9565.
